column1: 402821|complete|All q>=2,d>=1 and all continuous simplex maps are quantified.|Disjoint-face coincidences are a topological Tverberg assertion, not a finite feasibility test. Non-prime-power obstruction is a known-theorem lead, not independently cleared here; no new full-scope construction.

402823|complete|Finite real Banach dimension m>133 and universal subspace-isometry hypothesis are explicit.|A single exceptional dimension does not bound ambient dimension or reduce to finitely many norms. No tractable full-scope rigidity argument identified.

402831|definition-dependent|Level, size and the cell-based pole convention require the report; k domain is omitted.|Uniform cells differs from uniform area. A sampling argument must preserve that distribution and the exact constant; cannot certify from a generic arrangement bound.

402837|scope-ambiguous|Large and say n/10 leave exact intended constant and rounding unsettled.|Alpha(G)<=2 alone supplies only Ramsey bounds, not a linear clique. A counterexample must be realizable as a simplicial 4-polytope; arbitrary dense graphs do not suffice.

402850|definition-dependent|Field characteristic and general-linear-form setup are explicitly external.|Six finite pairs look computable via graded multiplication ranks, but a specialized rank defect alone cannot establish generic failure. Literal reports an existing result; no credit route.

402859|definition-dependent|Sym-invariant chain and coefficient field are unspecified; SLP/WLP are two distinct alternatives.|Eventual truth needs uniform control of multiplication ranks along the chain. Fixed-n checks cannot settle either property for every large n; corrupted formatting retained.

402862|scope-ambiguous|Sample regularity/version and whether infinite exponents are allowed are unstated.|Positive density near zero does not itself supply a stated path regularity hypothesis. Persistence needs continuous-time estimates and limiting subadditivity; no bounded certificate route.

402868|definition-dependent|Both reinforcement transition rules and convergence mode depend on the report.|Finite graphs still have evolving unbounded weights. Need exact rule and almost-sure versus probabilistic convergence; simulating a few graphs would not decide all graphs.

402882|definition-dependent|h_J^- and especially exclusion of Proposition3.21 require its actual construction.|Existential example needs nonintegrability and cohomology dimension plus proof of exclusion from that family; overlaps next row and cannot count twice.

402883|definition-dependent|Unidentified [3] Proposition3.21 is essential to what examples are excluded.|Contained in the first clause of 402882. No independent example beyond the excluded construction established; duplicate scope retained in literal coverage.

402890|complete|Every c.e. T and S and the local/global interpretability equivalence are explicit.|Literal itself attributes an affirmative R(T) construction. Treat as reported known, not a new existence proof; actual dependency body unaudited.

402894|scope-ambiguous|Natural test sets is undefined and existential T conflicts with universal T in the preorder.|Fixing a finite or easy test set can trivialize an altered question. Cannot replace naturality or the quantifier order with a convenient version.

402901|definition-dependent|Theorem4 graph, alpha-immersion and central-point conditions are absent.|At most three suggests elimination of an algebraic central-point equation, but degree and admissibility inequalities are unknown. No justified polynomial bound or computation.

402928|definition-dependent|S(V), rank topology, horizon and topology on V are not defined.|A metric on actual processes can fail separation when the topology identifies laws. Must settle quotient and state-space assumptions before a metric construction.

402929|definition-dependent|Iterated prediction, signature maps, tensor norm and rank topology are external.|A norm difference gives a pseudometric formally, but inducing precisely tau_r requires injectivity and convergence theorems. The formal triangle inequality is only a helper.

402930|complete|Universal reduced bounded-variation paths, signature levels and projective norm are specified.|The upper bound follows the usual factorial variation estimate; the equality requires a matching asymptotic lower bound for every reduced path. Polygonal cases do not settle scope.
402936|incomplete|No equation, class of steady states or stability topology is given.|A research-program sentence cannot define a universal stability theorem; no missing-scope replacement.

402937|incomplete|Reference[14] is unidentified and no target stability assertion is stated.|Beyond symmetry and linearization does not specify a PDE, norm, perturbation class or quantifiers. No literal theorem to certify.

402956|complete|All degree sequences 3<=d_n<=n-3 and the uniform regular matrix model are explicit.|Fixed-degree or dense-degree estimates need uniform bridging across intermediate regimes. A finite singular matrix is irrelevant to a vanishing-probability statement.

402961|complete|All integers n,d>=2 and all n real d-vectors are explicit.|Primary report pp403-405 already states and proves exactly this matrix PSD claim: M is the Schur product of half-angle cosine Gram matrices and M circle M >= J/n. Excluded as source-proved, no novelty inference needed.

402966|definition-dependent|Corrupted b1-invariants and p-atoral condition need Theorem4 definitions.|Positive scalar curvature requires surgery/index obstruction control for the full spin class. Vanishing an unspecified invariant cannot justify an adaptation from a nonspin theorem.

402968|complete|For RFRS groups of type FP_n(Q), both finite-index fibering and all i<=n vanishing are explicit.|Both implications require homological finiteness of kernels, not merely an epimorphism to Z. Known virtual-fibering theorem lead remains unchecked; no short independent route.

402988|complete|Existence among closed orientable smooth four-manifolds and Diff_0 is explicit.|A witness needs unbounded commutator length in the identity component, not merely nontrivial abelianization elsewhere. No suitable quasimorphism identified.

403001|complete|Every finite G, prime p and Sylow P with all induced constituents is explicit.|Normal P makes constituents factor through G/P, giving the easy direction. Converse requires a character-theoretic detection mechanism; one direction or small groups are helpers only.

403012|definition-dependent|D_C(rho) representation convention and k domain are not explicitly defined.|Universal Kronecker positivity across every partition at every staircase size has no small full-scope certificate. Character-table instances cannot establish the conjecture.

403029|scope-ambiguous|Domain finiteness and core/idempotence conventions of Gamma and WNU are missing.|Literal expressly reports a 2017 proof. Even after restoring finite-domain hypotheses this is a known result, not an eligible adaptation.

403033|incomplete|Estimate(5), dynamics, p range and vortex separation hypotheses are missing.|Theorem-labelled fragment cannot be assessed without the target estimate. Numerical vortex checks would not fill that gap.

403050|definition-dependent|G,F_0, domain class and equation(3) are undefined.|Equality of relaxation/entropy functionals needs both inequalities under exact boundary assumptions. No independent bounded computation or complete route.

403094|definition-dependent|DVI definition, allowed degeneracy and order conditions require source.|High-order composition may destroy the degeneracy that removes parasitic modes. Generic integrator order-raising is not a full-scope DVI construction.

403095|scope-ambiguous|Collision treatment and meaning of convergent series in physical versus reparametrized time are unclear.|Literal attributes prior Sundman/Wang solutions. Restoring the correct formulation would be a wording/source correction, not a new result.

403100|incomplete|All deformation/Hecke objects, auxiliary data and compatibility hypotheses are absent.|Existence of the displayed homomorphism is not testable from symbol names. The characteristic-polynomial clause alone cannot construct a map.

403111|incomplete|Relationship of F to discretely valued k is not stated.|Local-global principles over function fields need the exact base-field and valuation setup. Reading it as arbitrary F would change the problem.

403113|complete|All complete equicharacteristic regular local A and reductive A-group schemes are quantified.|Comparison across residue, ring and fraction field needs R-equivalence specialization and lifting; no uniform elementary bridge identified. Small split groups do not suffice.

403115|scope-ambiguous|Base field, category and representability category are not specified.|Hom representability depends on whether schemes, group schemes or finite-type algebraic groups are allowed. No classification can be promoted until this is fixed.

403128|definition-dependent|Skip operation and its totality convention are external; equivalent clause drops arithmetical.|An infinite sequence of nontotal skips needs a uniform priority construction, not a single degree or finitely many jumps. No bounded witness route.

403130|complete|Every properly 2-c.e.-degree D, existence of c.e. A, and all c.e. W are explicit.|Requires simultaneous lower-cone inclusion and nonreducibility of D. A finite enumeration cannot decide those requirements; no short construction identified.

403163|complete|For each epsilon>0 the WP genus-g small-eigenvalue probability tends to zero.|This is an asymptotic spectral-gap distribution assertion; fixed-genus calculations are not decisive. Needs geometric/probabilistic bounds uniform in g.

403164|incomplete|No class of quartics, tropicalization assumptions or lifting data is stated.|Recovering four numbers is not a theorem until curve degeneracy and real-lift rules are fixed; no replacement with generic quartics.

403169|definition-dependent|Wonderful model and det Q_M construction are not defined.|Arbitrary characteristic rules out a casual Kodaira-vanishing argument. Need a characteristic-free positivity or explicit cohomology mechanism for every realized matroid.

403172|scope-ambiguous|n and marked-point convention are free in the minimal-stratum notation.|General type requires global pluricanonical/birational constructions for all g>=12, not a low-dimensional count. Markings can change the dimension and assertion.

403218|scope-ambiguous|Subject to interpretation and generic region do not specify a single quantified SYZ statement.|Measure fraction alone does not define fibration singularities, metric limit or family. No formal target should be invented.

403222|definition-dependent|E_rho, maximality normalization and Hermitian-group hypotheses require definitions.|Already labelled Theorem2. Two stationary points require distinct conformal structures, not two parametrizations; existing-result lead rather than a new proof.

403235|definition-dependent|The c_d spectral invariants and Calabi normalization are not defined.|All compactly supported area-preserving disc maps require uniform asymptotics; special Hamiltonians or normalization checks are not full scope.

403244|definition-dependent|Germ-typicality and dissipative bicycle are explicitly source-defined.|Literal states an affirmative local theorem. Reproving the stated result would be ineligible; global typicality is a separate stronger question not licensed here.

403249|definition-dependent|gamma invariant, allowed homogeneous spaces and Lagrangian conventions are missing.|A uniform C for all exact L needs a geometric bound independent of L; scaling and graphs alone do not address arbitrary Lagrangians.

403255|complete|Every finite group is requested over Q and regularly over Q(t).|Inverse Galois and regular inverse Galois require arbitrary groups; realizations of families or one group are excluded instances. No short universal construction.

403259|definition-dependent|Primitive-field convention and allowed integral model are not fixed.|Density-one integral-point equality needs counting exceptional number fields and excluding constant/subfield mechanisms. Finite-degree examples do not establish 100 percent.
403264|incomplete|Prime variable is lost and the list of 22 images is absent.|Cannot test completeness of an unidentified exceptional-image list; no substitute list or guessed prime convention.

403266|definition-dependent|K(q) and the quintic construction generating A_n are absent.|Lambert expansion alone permits arbitrary coefficients and imposes no integrality. Need the exact mirror-period definition; no coefficient sweep justifies every n.

403268|complete|For every positive m infinitely many simple abelian varieties over F2 are required, dimension unrestricted.|Honda-Tate-style construction must enforce irreducibility, Weil bounds and fixed evaluation m uniformly. One polynomial per m or nonsimple products is insufficient; known-result lead unchecked.
